verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals ships on-call schedules with rotations, and a changelog entry confirms that schedule overrides exist ("Preserved OnCall Schedule Overrides"). That is a direct but thin signal for the override part of the story; nothing shows engineers can take overrides themselves rather than through an admin, and shift swaps and coverage requests are not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: evidence that non-admin on-call engineers can self-serve overrides, a documented shift-swap workflow, a coverage-request workflow, documentation of the override feature beyond a changelog title, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can take an override, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule

citations.quote: Rotations: A rotation defines the timing and assignment of on-call shifts.
Signals offers a complete alerting solution with on-call schedules, escalation policies, and multi-platform notifications
